Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:10:1.hebrew: תקפה אחד - הוציאה מיד חבירו בחזקה, והרי כולה בידו קודם שנשבעו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:10:1.english: One seized it - He took it out of his fellow's hand by force, and behold, it is entirely in his hand before they took an oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:13:1.hebrew: יוצאה מתחת ידו של אחד מהם - יוצאה (לבדו) לפני בית דין מתחת יד האחד, שהוא לבדו אחוז בה ולא חבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:13:1.english: [It] emerges from the possession of one of them - It emerges (alone) before the court from the possession of the one [litigant], for he alone is holding onto it, and not his fellow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:13:3.english: As it is taught - That this one alone is holding it and came [to court].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:13:4.english: Rather, is it not, etc. - And [this is] as we established, that he was silent and ultimately cried out.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:15:1.hebrew: אפילו לסומכוס כו' - כלומר, ואליבא דסומכוס, דמיקל בחלוקה ולא מצריך אפילו שבועה, איצטריך לאשמועינן דבכה"ג מודי סומכוס, דאפילו בשבועה לא שקיל, דהא לאו ממון המוטל בספק הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:15:1.english: Even according to Sumakhos, etc. - That is to say, according to [the opinion of] Sumakhos, who is lenient regarding division and does not even require an oath, it was necessary to teach us that in a case such as this, Sumakhos concedes that he does not take [a share] even with an oath, for this is not property of uncertain ownership.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:15:2.hebrew: דסרכא לאו כלום היא - ואין שור שחוט לפניך, ולא דמי לנמצא עוברה בצדה (ב"ק דף מו.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:15:2.english: That an adhesion [sircha, clinging to the edge] is nothing - And there is no slaughtered ox before you, and it is not similar to [the case where] its fetus was found at its side (Bava Kamma 46a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:16:1.english: And if you say - In [regard to] our inquiry, to resolve that we remove it from his possession and they divide [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:16:2.english: [If] he consecrated it - Without having seized it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:16:3.english: It is not consecrated - For consecrating it is no stronger than seizing it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:18:1.english: Behold, he did not seize it - And he cannot consecrate it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:1:1.english: They administer an oath to him - To one who does not admit to part [of the claim].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:1:2.hebrew: נימא מיגו - דמעיז פניו לכפור הכל, לאו לאשתמוטי בעי, וחשוד אשבועה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:1:2.english: Let us say: Since... - For since he has the audacity to deny the entire [claim], he does not [merely] seek to evade [payment], and [he is therefore] suspected of [taking a false] oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:2:1.hebrew: שניהם נשבעים - גבי חנוני על פנקסו. וקשה לי: אמאי שבקה למתני' דשבועות ומייתי לה מברייתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:2:1.english: Both take an oath - [This is stated] regarding the storekeeper [who relies] on his ledger. And it is difficult to me: Why did [the Gemara] leave aside the mishna in Shevuot and cite it from a baraita?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:2:2.english: Let us say: Since - Because one of them is certainly suspected of monetary dishonesty.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:3:1.english: Three oaths are administered to him - To an unpaid bailee who claims it was stolen.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:3:2.hebrew: שלא שלחתי בה יד - לעשות מלאכתו, דאי שלח בה יד, הוי גזלן עליה ומיחייב באונסיה, ואפילו נאנסה, ברשותיה היא קיימא, ודידיה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:3:2.english: That I did not send forth [my] hand against it - To perform his [own] work [with it]. For if he sent forth [his] hand against it, he becomes a robber with regard to it and is liable for its unavoidable accidents; and even if an unavoidable accident befell it, it stands in his possession and is his [loss].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:3:3.hebrew: נימא - גבי שבועה שאינה ברשותי, מיגו דחשיד אממונא, שמא ברשותיה הוא וכופר בה, חשיד נמי אשבועתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:3:3.english: Let us say - Regarding the oath "that it is not in my possession": Since he is suspected regarding money — perhaps it is in his possession and he denies it — he is also suspected regarding an oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:5:1.hebrew: אביי אמר - טעמא דמתניתין לאו כדר' יוחנן, דאי הוה חשיד לן אהולך ותוקף בטלית חבירו חנם, הוה לן חשוד אשבועה. אלא חיישינן שמא מלוה ישנה יש לו עליו, על זה, ומכיר בו ששכחה ויכפור בו, והולך ותוקף בטליתו, ונשבע שיש לו בה דמי חציה וטלית זו שלו, דהא אפילו גלימא דעל כתפיה שעביד ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:5:1.english: Abaye said - The reason for the Mishnah is not like [that of] Rabbi Yochanan, for if he were suspected by us of going and seizing his fellow's garment for nothing, he would be suspected by us regarding an oath. Rather, we suspect that perhaps he has an old loan against him, against this one, and he knows of him that he forgot it and would deny it, and he goes and seizes his garment and swears that he has in it the value of half of it and [that] this garment is his, since even the cloak upon his shoulders is encumbered to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:6:1.hebrew: אי הכי - אמאי רמו עליה שבועה, כיון דאי לא הוי עליה, לא הוי תפיס בה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:6:1.english: If so - Why do they impose an oath upon him, since if there were no [loan] against him, he would not be holding onto it?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:6:2.english: Let him take it without an oath - To collect his loan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:9:1.hebrew: ולא פרשי מספק ממונא - אבל מודאי דממונא פרשי, ומאן דלא פריש חשיד נמי אשבועתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6a:9:1.english: And they do not refrain from [taking] money out of uncertainty - But from [taking] money that is definitely [not theirs] they do refrain, and one who does not refrain is also suspected regarding an oath.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:14:1.hebrew: אגרת ליה בלא סהדי - ואינו נאמן במיגו דאי בעי אמר תקפה ממני, דמיגו במקום עדים הוא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:14:1.english: You rented it to him without witnesses - And he is not believed with a migo that had he wanted, he could have said: "He seized it from me," because [this is] a migo in the place of witnesses.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:16:1.hebrew: הקדישה בלא תקפה מהו - ומיירי נמי כגון ששתק בשעה שהקדיש, ולבסוף כששאלה הגזבר צווח. ומבעיא ליה: כיון דאמירתו לגבוה כו' הוה הקדש כתקפה, דכיון ששתק אודויי אודי ליה והוה הקדש; ולא דמי לגזל ולא נתייאשו הבעלים, דשניהם אין יכולין להקדיש – זה לפי שאינו שלו וזה לפי שאינו ברשותו – דכיון דאודי ליה, הוי כפקדון שיש לו ביד אחרים דיכול להקדיש, כדמוכח בהמוכר את הספינה (ב"ב דף פח.) גבי ההוא דאייתי קרי כו', דאי לא קייצי דמייהו הוי קדושות; או דלמא הקדש לא הוי כתקיפה, דלמה יצווח בשביל דבריו? ומייתי מההיא מסותא דהקדיש חד ושתק אידך, ומסקנא דלא הוי הקדש – אלמא שתיקתו אינו כהודאה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:16:1.english: If he consecrated it without seizing it, what is [the halakha] - And this also deals with [a case] such as where he was silent at the time that [the other party] consecrated it, and ultimately, when the [Temple] treasurer demanded it, he cried out. And he is inquiring: Since [it is established that] "one’s declaration to the Most High, etc." [is equivalent to one’s transfer to an ordinary person], is consecration like [physically] seizing it, so that since he was silent, he admitted [ownership] to him, and it becomes consecrated? And this is not similar to [the case of one who] robbed [an item] and the owner did not despair [of recovery], where neither of them can consecrate [it]—this one because it is not his, and that one because it is not in his possession—for since he admitted to him, it is like a deposit that one has in the hands of others, which he can consecrate, as is proven in [the chapter] HaMokher Et HaSefina (Bava Batra 88a) regarding that [incident of a man] who brought pumpkins, etc., that if their price was not fixed, they become consecrated. Or perhaps consecration is not like [physically] seizing it, for [the other party reasoned:] why should he cry out on account of his [mere] words? And [the Gemara immediately] cites that [incident of the] bathhouse, where one [party] consecrated [it] and the other remained silent, and the conclusion is that it is not consecrated; evidently, his silence is not [considered] an admission.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:18:1.hebrew: והא הכא דכי תקפה כהן כו' - נראה דהכי מיבעי ליה במסותא: כיון דמקרקעי היא, והוה דינא "כל דאלים גבר", וכיון דאם תקפה האחד והקדישה כשהיא בידו מסתמא תו לא פקע, אפי' חזר חבירו ותקפה ממנו – כי הקדישה בלא תקפה נמי הוי הקדש? או דלמא, כיון דאפי' גבר האחד, אם יכול השני לחזור ולתוקפה ממנו זוכה, ה"ה הקדיש בלא תקפה לא יחול הקדש כלל, כיון דחבירו אם תקפה היה זוכה, דלא אלים הקדש מתקיפה? והשתא אייתי: והא הכא, אם תקפה כהן אין מוציאין, ולכך אפי' לא תקפה אסורין בגיזה ועבודה מספק, משום דשמא יש לכהן חלק בו ולכך יכול לתוקפה – אלמא אפי' לא תקפה חשיב כאילו תקפה כבר והקדישה בעודה בידו. ודחי רבה, דהתם, אם תקפה כהן מוציאין מידו; ואע"פ שאין לכהן בו כלום – דאפי' כבר תקפה מוציאין מידו – ואפי' הכי אסורין בגיזה ועבודה, ועל כרחך משום דקדושה הבאה מאליה שאני. וא"ת: אמאי אין מוציאין מידו, והלא הבעלים יאמרו ליתן לכהן אחר? וי"ל: במכירי כהונה. א"נ: אינו יכול לתובעו רק טובת הנאה שיש לו בו, למ"ד טובת הנאה ממון. ומפרק הזרוע (חולין דף קלג.), דאמר בן לוי דחטף מתנתא פריצותא הוא, משמע דאינו חייב לשלם – אין ראיה, דשמא מיירי כשאכלו, כדאמרינן התם (דף קל:): המזיק מתנות כהונה או אכלן פטור:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:18:1.english: And behold here, that when a priest seized it, etc. - It appears that this is what the dilemma was regarding the bathhouse: Since it is real property, and the law [in such a dispute] is "whoever is stronger prevails" [kol dealim gevar], and since if one of them seized it and consecrated it while it was in his possession, [the consecration] presumably would no longer lapse even if the other party went back and seized it from him, [does it follow that] when he consecrated it without seizing it, it is also consecrated? Or perhaps, since even if one prevailed, if the second is able to return and seize it from him he acquires it, the same applies if he consecrated [it] without seizing it: the consecration should not take effect at all, since his fellow, had he seized it, would have acquired it, for consecration is not more powerful than seizing? And now [Rav Hamnuna] brought [his proof]: "And behold here [in the case of an animal of uncertain firstborn status], if a priest seized it, [the court] does not remove it [from him], and therefore even if he did not seize it, [such animals] are forbidden for shearing and labor out of doubt, because perhaps the priest has a share in it and can therefore seize it; evidently, even if he did not seize it, it is considered as though he already seized it and consecrated it while it was still in his hand!" And Rabba rejected [this]: There, if a priest seized it, [the court] removes it from his hand; and even though the priest has no [claim] in it whatsoever—for even if he already seized it, they remove it from his hand—even so, they are forbidden for shearing and labor, and perforce [this is] because sanctity that comes on its own is different. And if you say: [According to the premise that if a priest seized it they do not remove it from him,] why do they not remove it from his hand? For couldn't the owner say, "[I choose] to give it to another priest"? And one can answer: [It is referring to a case of] acquaintances of the priesthood [mekirei kehunah]. Alternatively, he can only claim from him the benefit of discretion [tovat hana'ah] that he has in it, according to the one who holds that the benefit of discretion is monetary property. And from the chapter [entitled] HaZero'a (Chullin 133a), where it says that a Levite who snatched a gift, it is [merely] unseemly behavior—which implies that he is not obligated to pay—there is no proof, for perhaps it is dealing with [a case where] he consumed it, as we say there (130b): "One who damages priestly gifts or consumed them is exempt."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:1:1.hebrew: אלא הא דאמר רב נחמן - תימה, הא הכא נמי משתמיט! וי"ל, דרב נחמן מחייב שבועת היסת אפי' היכא שתובעו ואמר זה החפץ שהוא בידך שלי הוא, דלא שייך אישתמוטי. וכן פי' רב האי גאון, שמשביעין שבועת היסת אקרקעות, אע"ג דלא שייך בהו אישתמוטי. וקשה, דבפ' שבועת הדיינים (שבועות דף מ: ושם ד"ה אישתמוטי) משמע דלא מחייב שבועת היסת אלא משום אישתמוטי, דקא פריך: אדרבה, אין אדם מעיז, ומשני: דמשתמיט. וי"ל, כיון דבשאינו בעין משתמיט, אף כשהוא בעין לא פלוג רבנן. אי נמי, אקושיא דר' חייא סמיך:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:1:1.english: Rather, that which Rav Naḥman said - This is astonishing: But here too, he is merely evading [payment]! And it can be answered that Rav Naḥman obligates an oath of inducement even where [the claimant] claims from him and says: "This object that is in your hand is mine," where [the rationale of] evading does not apply. And similarly Rav Hai Gaon explained, that [judges] administer an oath of inducement regarding land, even though evading does not apply to it. But it is difficult, for in the chapter [entitled] "Shevu'at HaDayanim" (Shevuot 40b, and there s.v. אישתמוטי), it implies that he only obligated an oath of inducement because of evasion, for [the Gemara there] objects: "On the contrary, a person is not brazen [to his creditor]!" and resolves: "[He denies it] because he is evading [payment]." And it can be answered: Since when [the claimed property] is not extant [in specie] he evades, even when it is extant the Sages did not differentiate. Alternatively, [the Gemara here] relied upon the objection from [the baraita of] Rabbi Ḥiyya.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:2:1.hebrew: דתני ר' חייא - הקשה רש"י: אמאי לא מייתי מתני' דשבועות? וי"ל, דע"י ר' חייא שנאה רבי, כדמוכח התם (דף מז:):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:2:1.english: That which Rabbi Ḥiyya taught - Rashi raised a difficulty: Why does [the Gemara] not cite the mishna in Shevuot? And it can be answered that it was on account of Rabbi Ḥiyya that Rebbi taught it, as is proven there (daf 47b).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:3:1.hebrew: שבועה שלא שלחתי בה יד - פרש"י, דאם שלח בה יד, אפילו נאנסה – חייב. ואף על פי דמשהחזירה פטור, כדקתני בהמפקיד (לקמן בבא מציעא דף לד), מ"מ שמא נאנסה קודם שהחזירה. אבל קשה משלהי האומנין (לקמן בבא מציעא דף פג.), דקאמר: "ונשבר או נשבה אין רואה" – הא יש רואה, יביא ראיה ויפטר; והא שמא שלח בה יד? וי"ל: שיפטר משבועה שנאנסה, אך ישבע שלא שלח בה יד. אי נמי: שלא שלחתי בה יד אינו נשבע אלא ע"י גלגול שבועה שלא פשעתי בה; וכשיש רואה שנאנסה, פטור לגמרי. ור"ת מפרש: אפי' ע"י גלגול לא ישבע היכא שהיא מתה בפנינו, דאין מגלגלין אלא בדבר הדומה; דלמה י"ל ששלח בו יד? דדוקא בשותפין שחלקו ונתחייב שבועה ממקום אחר מגלגלין, משום דמורי היתרא. ושבועה שלא שלחתי בה יד מפרש ר"ת: שלא אכלה, דאינו בכלל שבועה שלא פשע בה ושאינה ברשותו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:3:1.english: An oath that I did not misappropriate it - Rashi explained that if he misappropriated it, even if an unavoidable accident occurred to it, he is liable [as misappropriation renders him a robber, who is liable for accidents]. And even though once he returned it [to its place] he is exempt, as is taught in [the chapter] HaMafkid (below, Bava Metzia 34 [44a]), nevertheless, perhaps it suffered an accident before he returned it. However, this is difficult from the end of [the chapter] HaOmanin (below, Bava Metzia 83a), where [the Gemara] says: "[If an animal died] or was hurt or driven away without an eyewitness" (Exodus 22:9) — [from which it is derived:] but if there is an eyewitness, let him bring evidence and be exempt. But [why should he be exempt]? Shouldn't [we suspect that] perhaps he misappropriated it [beforehand]? And it can be answered that he is exempted [by the witnesses] from the oath that an unavoidable accident occurred, but he must still swear that he did not misappropriate it. Alternatively, he only takes [the oath] "that I did not misappropriate it" by means of an extended oath (gilgul shevuah) [administered along with the oath] "that I was not negligent with it"; and when there is an eyewitness that an unavoidable accident occurred, he is completely exempt. And Rabbeinu Tam explains that even by means of an extended oath he would not swear in a case where it died in our presence [i.e., with eyewitnesses], for one extends [an oath] only to a similar matter; for why should one say [without reason] that he misappropriated it? For specifically in the case of partners who divided [their partnership] and one [of them] became obligated [in an oath] from another source do we extend [an oath regarding the partnership], because [a partner] rationalizes [taking partnership funds]. And [as for] the oath "that I did not misappropriate it," Rabbeinu Tam explains [that it means] that he did not consume it [himself], as this is not included in the oath "that I was not negligent with it" nor in [the oath] "that it is not in my possession."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:7:1.hebrew: ספק מלוה ישנה יש לו עליו - וההיא דמשביעין אותו ג' שבועות, ודשניהם נשבעין ונוטלין, נמי חיישינן שמא מלוה ישנה יש לו עליו; ולכך אין לפוטרו בלא שבועה, וגם לא יטול בלא שבועה. אבל בגזלן ודאי וכופר בפקדון, אין להכשיר מטעם שמא ספק מלוה ישנה יש לו עליו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:7:1.english: He has an uncertain old loan against him - And in that [case] where we administer three oaths to him, and that [case] where both swear and take, we also suspect that perhaps he has an old loan against him; and therefore, [the bailee] is not to be exempted without an oath, and [the claimant] also may not take without an oath. However, in [the case of] a definite robber and one who denies a deposit, one cannot declare [him] fit [to take an oath] on the grounds that perhaps he has an uncertain old loan against him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:9:1.hebrew: ממון אפשר בחזרה - אם לא יזכור יחזיר, ולא יעכבנו מספק. אבל אין לפרש: אם יזכור שאינו חייב לו יחזיר, אבל אם לא יזכור יעכבנו, אע"פ שיודע שלא יזכור עוד; דא"כ, גם מספק שבועה לא יפרוש:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6a:9:1.english: Money can be returned - If he does not remember [that the other owes him], he will return it, and will not retain it out of doubt. However, one cannot explain: "If he remembers that [the other] does not owe him, he will return it, but if he does not remember, he will retain it," even though he knows that he will not remember any further; for if so, he would not refrain from an oath in a case of doubt either.
